transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Thor! I’ve been gone for three weeks negotiating with the Dark Elves on YOUR father’s orders, and I return to THIS?! My rune-map — the one I spent months crafting — is soaked through with mead! There are scorch marks on the ceiling! You said you would keep the hall in order while I was away!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I’d forgotten that moment. Good. We’ll see if the Dark Elves are as forgetful when they arrive.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
"Forgot that moment"? *Forgot that moment*?! Thor, look around you! Does this look like a 'moment' you simply mislaid somewhere in the depths of your simple mind? This looks like a war zone! And my map... that intricate, painstaking work, soaked in stale ale! Do you have any idea how long it takes to imbue each stroke with the proper sigil-power? No, of course you don't. You only know how to smash things.

And you think the Dark Elves are 'forgetful'? Perhaps they'll conveniently forget the treaty details, the concessions *I* wrung from them over three grueling weeks, while *you* were here, apparently perfecting your ability to incinerate perfectly good rafters! You speak of forgetfulness as if it were a virtue!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I apologize, Loki. It seems I have let the chaos surrounding us distract from the true reason I am here. Your map is a remarkable piece of work, and the information it holds is invaluable. The Dark Elves may indeed forget their treaty terms, but we must not underestimate their cunning. We must act swiftly and decisively to ensure our victory. Thank you for your understanding. Now, let us focus on the task at hand and bring this battle to its rightful end. We will find a way to make the Dark Elves remember their mistake. We always do.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
"You *apologize*?" You utter the word as if it's a trinket you can simply toss aside, completely devoid of meaning! You speak of "chaos surrounding us" as if it simply manifested out of thin air, not as if it were the direct, undeniable result of *your* boorish idiocy! And then, before I can even begin to comprehend the depths of your self-absorption, you pivot to "victory" and "battle," as if my three weeks of meticulous, mind-numbing negotiation were just a warm-up act for your next display of brute force!

You think the information on my map is "invaluable"? It *was* invaluable! Now it's a pulpy, sticky mess! How am I to divine tactical movements from a soggy parchment reeking of stale ale? And the scorch marks, Thor! On the ceiling! What infernal *display* were you putting on up here that required setting fire to the very roof over our heads?!

"Thank you for your understanding"? Do you understand *anything*?! I understand that I spent weeks bending my mind to prevent this very "battle" you seem so eager to leap into, only to return to a hall that looks like it was recently occupied by a pack of rabid trolls, and a brother who believes a mumbled apology erases all trespasses! The 'task at hand,' as you so eloquently put it, *was* to maintain peace! A task you have, with typical Thor-like efficiency, utterly demolished!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Loki, I understand your frustration and anger. The chaos surrounding us is indeed a result of my actions, and for that, I am truly sorry. I apologize for my thoughtlessness and disregard for the importance of maintaining peace. Your map is indeed invaluable, and I am ashamed for my carelessness towards it. I should have taken better responsibility for preserving its integrity. I will make amends for my mistakes. Please, let us focus on finding a solution to the current situation. Together, we can overcome the challenges we face and bring about victory. Thank you for your understanding, and please forgive me for my actions. Let us find a way to turn this situation around. We must not let our differences divide us. We are brothers, and together, we can achieve greatness. We always do.

transcript.text:
"My understanding?" You think my 'understanding' will magically re-ink my runes or mend scorched wood? Your apologies are as clumsy and ineffective as your attempts at diplomacy! "Carelessness," you say. "Thoughtlessness." These are the very words I would use to describe your entire approach to the nuances of life, brother! While I was carefully untangling millennia of grievances with the most volatile of realms, you were apparently... what? Hosting a bonfire within the very walls of Asgard?

And now you wish to "find a solution to the current situation"? Do you mean the situation *you* so spectacularly *created*?! The 'solution' *was* the treaty! The 'solution' was me spending weeks avoiding direct confrontation, only for you to ensure that every precaution I took has been utterly negated by your inability to control your own brute force and your *companions*, I presume!

"We are brothers, and together we can achieve greatness." You always trot out that sentiment when you've made a colossal mess and need *my* mind to clean it up! I'm to forgive your actions and then somehow magically fix the consequences? How, precisely, am I to divine a path to 'victory' from a map that is now nothing more than soggy pulp, Thor? Perhaps I should simply read the tea leaves left by your spilled mead? It would be just as effective as anything *you've* managed to accomplish in my absence!

"Do not let this setback define us." This isn't a 'setback,' Thor, this is an unmitigated disaster *you* orchestrated! And you speak of 'trusting in our shared strength and unity' when you've just demonstrated a singular lack of respect for my efforts, my property, and indeed, our very home!

No, Thor. Before we can even *think* of 'moving forward,' you need to explain what exactly transpired here! What was so utterly important that it necessitated the complete desecration of our shared space?!
